headline.text: L2 panning failed visual inspection for *almond residue* inside machine at changeover — allergen cross-contact risk.

summary: Three active holds: metal-in-product pecan lot at L1 S3, overweight cream barrels at L3 ML4, and 180 trays of L1 S3 pecan clusters for color defects. One sanitation failure at L2 panning (almond residue), one foreign-material risk at L3 ML4 (gasket found out of position during depositor maintenance).

holds.title: Pecan lot on hold after metal detection
holds.summary: S3 detected metal in pecan lot mid-shift; Jorel Gourdin requested immediate lot change and hold on affected pecans.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition — Charity Young asked if entire lot or just tote; no final scope confirmed in window.

holds.title: Four cream barrels on hold — depositor 3 overweight
holds.summary: ML4 depositor 3 capture test showed cream weight out of range (high end of spec); Preston Tregaskis ordered hold, Nathan Gevenois marked and transported barrels to hold area.
holds.status: Physical hold labels applied, barrels moved to hold area, awaiting IMS LPN creation for formal disposition tracking.

holds.title: 180 trays S3 pecan clusters — color variation
holds.summary: Second shift QA flagged streaking and white spots insufficient for uniform palletizing; tech instructed to continue sorting on next shift.
holds.status: On hold for sorting — next shift notified to continue segregation as same defects appearing.

holds.title: Flow wrap rolls — silvering defect
holds.summary: Two rolls flagged yesterday with silvering around lettering; today three more found without QA labels.
holds.status: Angel Cabrera instructed Daniel McCarty to work with IMS to create new label with total quantity and complete hold disposition via NetSuite.

food_safety.title: Metal detected in S3 pecan lot
food_safety.summary: Metal detector flagged pecan lot during production; line supervisor immediately requested lot change to prevent 3-hit shutdown rule.
food_safety.status: Lot change completed, affected lot on hold pending scope determination (full lot vs. single tote).

food_safety.title: ML4 depositor gasket found out of position
food_safety.summary: During troubleshooting of shut-off rack fault, operators removed nozzle plate and found gasket displaced; QA inspected gasket for completeness before reinstallation with new gasket.
food_safety.status: Resolved — gasket confirmed complete by QA, new gasket installed, nozzle plate washed and reinstalled per Grey Boscan 14:47 MT.

food_safety.title: ML4 operator error — cream depositor off during run
food_safety.summary: Operator forgot to turn on cream depositor power button after capture test; four molds marked bad, manual rejection required as auto-reject not functioning for this defect type.
food_safety.status: Resolved — defective molds flagged, two EEs stationed at reject to manually ensure bad bars removed, operator coached per Rich Brierley.

quality.title: Truffle line 281 lbs scrap — weight failure
quality.summary: Truffle bite weights came in at 80g vs. 88–90g spec, too low to adjust; entire batch scrapped.
quality.status: Resolved — 281 lbs chocolate scrap documented, third shift completed changeover to milk chocolate.

quality.title: ML4 depositor 3 capture test out of range
quality.summary: Initial capture test showed cream weight high; operator indicated would adjust but not retest — Preston insisted on passing in-spec test before restart.
quality.status: Resolved — retest at 07:56 MT showed in-spec for both cream and caramel, but both at top end; barrels produced during out-of-spec window placed on hold.

quality.title: ML4 bottom shell thickness out of spec
quality.summary: Mirella Mamani reported average 1.25 mm vs. 1.5 mm minimum spec at 08:21 MT; Preston attributed to high cream and caramel deposit weights at top end of spec.
quality.status: Under monitoring — Preston requested continued checks every 30 min (vs. hourly) until flagged molds clear system; 09:42 update confirmed rejection working better and bars looking good.

quality.title: ML4 yellow bars missing cream
quality.summary: Operator failed to turn cream depositor back on after capture test; defect caught, EE coached.
quality.status: Resolved — operator coached, molds flagged, manual rejection confirmed at de-mold station.

sanitation.title: Panning visual inspection failed — almond residue
sanitation.summary: Wilson Amaris Cabrera reported almond residue found inside panning machine during pre-run visual inspection at 03:56 MT.
sanitation.status: Open — no follow-up posted in window showing re-clean or ATP retest results.

sanitation.title: S1 pack area equipment left running overnight
sanitation.summary: Third-shift maintenance (Dakota) found pack area belts and X-rays running at startup; Nathan Coles shut down, coaching requested.
sanitation.status: Resolved — equipment shut down, Jody Howse requested team coaching on shutdown procedures.

sanitation.title: MFM level 2 clean completed and passed
sanitation.summary: Janeth Sanchez confirmed visual and ATP checks satisfactory after overnight level 2 clean.
sanitation.status: Resolved — visual and ATP both passed, line ready for production.

opportunities.text: Review S1 end-of-shift shutdown checklist completeness — pack area belts and X-rays were left running overnight.
Review panning pre-op inspection sign-off process — based on almond residue found at 03:56 with no documented resolution or re-clean verification in the 6+ hours remaining in the window.
Consider adding depositor gasket position to ML4 startup visual checklist — based on today's out-of-position gasket found during shut-off rack troubleshooting.
Review ML4 capture-test-to-startup handoff procedure — today's operator forgot to re-enable cream depositor after test, and a separate event showed resistance to retesting after out-of-spec result.
